description_en: Queries the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) connection information for instances. This operation is available only to standard networks
description_zh: 查询实例ADB连接信息（仅限标准网络）
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic list-instance-adb-attributes --instance-ids acp-5hh431emkt6u00000 --external-ip 106.38.188.223 --internal-ip 10.0.3.23 --internal-port 5555 --ip-protocol TCP --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAV3MpHK1AP0pfERHZN5pu6kU+SQXzm0H9mu/FiSc0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstanceAdbAttributes

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud phone instance IDs. You can specify from 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例ID列表，可设置 1~100 个
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return on each page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。取值范围1～100，默认值为100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that indicates the position from which the query starts. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 用来表示当前开始读取的位置。置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token
